changes.title: Beach
items: A secret for explorers: fly to the very edge of the world and you'll find a beach, with the calm dark sea mirroring the moon and stars and the sound of waves
Keep flying out to sea and she lands on the sand and lies back to look at the stars
Now and then other witches are hanging out on the beach: land near them and you'll chat, hold hands, hug and stargaze together

changes.title: Legend circle slow
items: Stepping into a sleeping legend's circle slows the whole world (the music, the countdown, every creature) to a tenth of its speed, while you keep yours
Angry creatures go round a sleeping legend's circle, and a 💌 that flies out of it vanishes in a sparkle

changes.title: Slow time music
items: Step into a sleeping legend's circle and the music slows down like a tape winding down, then speeds back up as you leave
Each legend's own music in its circle is slower and more spacious, floating over the slowed-down party
